dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: Please, Coach... I—I can't... If I c—could just rest for a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: I—I'm fine! I j—just need to catch my breath... I'm a m—merchant. I'm not used to w—working out so hard...

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: Phew, the training classes here are way more intense than I expected...

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: I thought I was signing up for a standard weight loss class. You know, some basic aerobics, a lecture or two on good nutrition... I never thought it would be this vigorous!

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: But I can't quit now — I've already pre-paid! I even bought a VIP membership... If only I'd known it would be this grueling, I'd have gone with my sister to the Masters of the Night-Wind...

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: Thanks for your encouragement! I've already paid for a VIP membership, so I'll see this through no matter what!

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: Yes, my sister and I are merchants from Fontaine. We're hoping to make some investments in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: She left me on my own and headed to the Masters of the Night-Wind. Apparently, she met some "Master Chicome" there and received some investment tips. She tells me she's made quite the profit.

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: Although, I have no idea how she's done it... That priest, Kabewa, she's from the Masters of the Night-Wind too, and she says they never give out investment tips to anyone. But... as long as she's turning a profit, who am I to complain?
